title: Efficacy of home phototherapy versus inpatient phototherapy for neonatal hyperbilirubinemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

evidence.reason: Inventory must identify exactly k distinct trials

adjudication.design_quote: Cohort study subgroup analysis yielded consistent results (SMD = 0.90; 95% CI: 0.69 to 1.11, P < 0.001, I 2 = 39%); the RCTs were not significantly different
adjudication.k_quote: Nine studies (998 patients) were included (four RCTs, five cohort studies).
adjudication.reason: Mixed review that reports a pooled RCT-only subgroup estimate, so it qualifies as a pairwise RCT synthesis.
